task_name: Name City and Construct Town Hall

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: Upon returning from Daniel's City when Advisor Eva prompts to name the city and construct the first Government building.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Naming the city personalizes it for trading, and building the Town Hall unlocks the City Journal, which provides structured milestone tasks with lucrative Simoleon chest rewards.
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Place Town Hall along an active road; it has no negative pollution radius.

steps.who: green 'Show me' button on Eva's Government prompt
steps.briefing: open the Services menu highlighting Government.
drag the Town Hall onto the road opposite the residential homes.
confirm placement of the Town Hall.
